EDUCATION

2021-PGDBA (MBA) in Operations Management, Symbiosis Institute, Pune

2004 Bachelor of Engineering (Electronics & Telecommunication), Mumbai University

CORE COMPETENCIES

Contact Center Transformation & Strategy

Enterprise Voice Technologies (AVAYA, SIP, VoIP)

Cloud & Digital Transformation (AWS, IVR Modernization)

Customer Experience Optimization (CX, AHT Reduction)

Program & Project Management (End-to-End Delivery)

Automation & AI (Voice Bots, Call Steering)

Vendor & Partner Management

Stakeholder	Management	&	Business Alignment

Budgeting & Cost Optimization

Audit, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

CRM & System Integration (Enterprise Platforms)

Operational	Excellence	&	Process Improvement

Incident Management & System Reliability (Uptime)

Team Leadership & Talent Development

Data-Driven Decision Making & Performance Metrics

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Languages & Database:

Oracle, SQL, Linux, Windows

Tools & Framework:

Avaya CM, AES, CMS, Session Manager • IVR, ACD, Dialers, Verint, NICE • SIP, H.323, VoIP AWS Cloud (IVR hosting, scalable architecture) Cloud IVR, Voice Bots, Automation

WORK EXPERIENCE

Assistance Vice President -IT

Projects: Portfolio Management Contact Center for BFSI, Vendor Management, People Management.

Tech Stack: Voice Network, Data Network, IVR Bot, Call routing, Infra management

Significant Highlights:

Leading and supervising teams, each having more than 4 financial/data analyst, developers and QA members.

Lead Contact Center technology strategy and operations, managing large-scale transformation initiatives and BAU delivery.

Drive end-to-end program management from scoping to deployment, including CRM integrations and IVR modernization.

Deliver Voice Bot and Call Steering solutions, significantly improving customer experience and reducing AHT.

Partner with business leaders to define strategy, identify gaps, and implement scalable technology solutions.

Manage multi-vendor ecosystem, ensuring SLA adherence, delivery governance, and performance optimization.

Oversee budgeting, cost optimization, and AMC lifecycle management.

Monitor and improve Cloud IVR performance metrics, ensuring high availability and efficiency.

Lead and mentor a team of 10+ professionals, driving performance, capability building, and career growth.

Ensure audit compliance, risk governance, and regulatory adherence across systems.

Contact center Delivery Manager – Global Voice and IT Suport

Projects: Risk Model, Expansion, Movements of Contact center business, Upgrades and Enhancement. TechStack: AVAYA (S87XX, Session Manager,AES, CMS, Media Gateways) | NICE | NIM 4.1

VoIP | SIP | H.323 | H.245 | TCP/IP | ISDN | Contact Center Integration

Significant Highlights:

Managed global contact center voice infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance across regions.

Led L3/Tier-3 escalations for complex voice issues, driving resolution through a cross-functional ecosystem including vendors and internal teams (30+ members).

Delivered multiple AVAYA IVR and ACD transformation projects, ensuring timely execution and adherence to project milestones.

Acted as Solution Architect, designing and implementing enterprise-grade voice and contact center solutions.

Owned capacity planning and uptime governance for critical voice systems, ensuring business continuity and reliability.

Governed voice change management processes, including approvals and compliance with banking standards.

Collaborated with integration and project teams to validate solution designs and ensure seamless deployment of new initiatives.

Worked closely with service providers to troubleshoot and resolve trunk and network-related issues.

Managed vendor relationships (AVAYA, NICE), ensuring delivery quality, timely escalations, and operational stability.

Supported NICE platform BAU operations and contributed to continuous service improvements.

Prepared and presented operational and performance reports to leadership for decision-making.

Significant Highlights:

Senior Telecom Engineer | Feb 2007 -Jun 2012

Provided global Tier-3 technical support for enterprise voice and SIP solutions across APAC, EMEA, and North America regions.

Recognized as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Avaya platforms including media servers, gateways, and wireless voice solutions.

Led troubleshooting of complex voice and SBC (Session Border Controller) issues, collaborating with Tier-4 and product engineering teams to resolve critical defects.

Played a key role in deployment, configuration, and upgrades of large-scale Avaya environments (S83xxâ€“S88xx, Communication Manager, SES).

Supported Avaya Aura suite including Session Manager, System Manager, and enterprise SIP architectures.

Managed end-to-end lifecycle activities including implementation, upgrades, patching, and performance optimization.

Provided support for converged communication systems (SIP, IP, digital, and analog telephony).

Collaborated with global customers and business partners to resolve high-impact production issues and ensure service continuity.

Accomplishments:

Acted as Process Champion for APAC, driving process standardization, quality improvements, and team capability building.

Worked on wireless voice solutions (DECT, Samsung, Polycom) and enterprise collaboration systems.

Utilized advanced testing and simulation tools (GERA, HAMMER, SVM) for issue replication and validation.

Contributed to internal initiatives, including project management in Techathon events, demonstrating leadership beyond core operations.

Clients: MEA and USASr. Engineer (Voice Solution and NWs)Duration: 2 yearsJan 2005 to Jan 2007Efunds Int Ltd (Allied Digital Ltd)

Projects – Banking and Insurance

Significant Highlights:

Provided support for telecom solutions for Efunds International, managing centralized Customer Care Center operations in Mumbai and remote locations including Gurgaon, US, UK, and Chennai.

Administered and maintained AVAYA DEFINITY Enterprise Communications Server and associated components across multiple sites.

Handled maintenance and troubleshooting of MCC (Multi Carrier Cabinet) and EPN (Expansion Port Network), including cards such as SNI (Switch Node Interface) and EI (Expansion Interface).

Performed system monitoring using IGX to ensure network stability and performance.

Managed Witness Server for call recording and ensured uninterrupted recording services.

Administered call center operations using CentreVu Call Management System (CMS) for reporting and analytics.

Configured and managed CLAN cards and E1/T1 interfaces.

Resolved CMS server-related issues and ensured high system availability.

Maintained system downtime records, inventory, and server access credentials.

Significant Highlights:

Managed maintenance and troubleshooting of AVAYA PBX systems including S8700 and G3R platforms.

Worked with major clients such as Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), supporting VoIP (Voice over IP) infrastructure for TCSâ€“Air India environment.

Served as Installation and Maintenance Engineer, responsible for deployment, configuration, and support of media gateways (G700) and IP telephony systems.

Delivered end-to-end installation and configuration of IP Phones and ensured seamless integration with enterprise networks.

Provided telecom solution support for ICICI Bank Ltd., managing centralized Customer Care Centers across Mumbai and Hyderabad.

Ensured high system availability and quick resolution of telecom/network issues in mission-critical environments.

Assistance Vice President -IT
Senior Telecom Engineer | Feb 2007 -Jun 2012
Provided global Tier-3 technical support for enterprise voice and SIP solutions across APAC, EMEA, and North America regions.
Recognized as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Avaya platforms including media servers, gateways, and wireless voice solutions.
Led troubleshooting of complex voice and SBC (Session Border Controller) issues, collaborating with Tier-4 and product engineering teams to resolve critical defects.
Played a key role in deployment, configuration, and upgrades of large-scale Avaya environments (S83xxâ€“S88xx, Communication Manager, SES).
Supported Avaya Aura suite including Session Manager, System Manager, and enterprise SIP architectures.
Managed end-to-end lifecycle activities including implementation, upgrades, patching, and performance optimization.
Provided support for converged communication systems (SIP, IP, digital, and analog telephony).
Collaborated with global customers and business partners to resolve high-impact production issues and ensure service continuity.
Accomplishments:
Acted as Process Champion for APAC, driving process standardization, quality improvements, and team capability building.
Worked on wireless voice solutions (DECT, Samsung, Polycom) and enterprise collaboration systems.
Utilized advanced testing and simulation tools (GERA, HAMMER, SVM) for issue replication and validation.
Contributed to internal initiatives, including project management in Techathon events, demonstrating leadership beyond core operations.
Clients: MEA and USASr. Engineer (Voice Solution and NWs)Duration: 2 yearsJan 2005 to Jan 2007Efunds Int Ltd (Allied Digital Ltd)
Projects – Banking and Insurance
Significant Highlights:
Provided support for telecom solutions for Efunds International, managing centralized Customer Care Center operations in Mumbai and remote locations including Gurgaon, US, UK, and Chennai.
Administered and maintained AVAYA DEFINITY Enterprise Communications Server and associated components across multiple sites.
Handled maintenance and troubleshooting of MCC (Multi Carrier Cabinet) and EPN (Expansion Port Network), including cards such as SNI (Switch Node Interface) and EI (Expansion Interface).
Performed system monitoring using IGX to ensure network stability and performance.
Managed Witness Server for call recording and ensured uninterrupted recording services.
Administered call center operations using CentreVu Call Management System (CMS) for reporting and analytics.
Configured and managed CLAN cards and E1/T1 interfaces.
Resolved CMS server-related issues and ensured high system availability.
Maintained system downtime records, inventory, and server access credentials.
Significant Highlights:
Managed maintenance and troubleshooting of AVAYA PBX systems including S8700 and G3R platforms.
Worked with major clients such as Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), supporting VoIP (Voice over IP) infrastructure for TCSâ€“Air India environment.
Served as Installation and Maintenance Engineer, responsible for deployment, configuration, and support of media gateways (G700) and IP telephony systems.
Delivered end-to-end installation and configuration of IP Phones and ensured seamless integration with enterprise networks.
Provided telecom solution support for ICICI Bank Ltd., managing centralized Customer Care Centers across Mumbai and Hyderabad.
Ensured high system availability and quick resolution of telecom/network issues in mission-critical environments.
